Seeking a strategic, results-driven Pharmacy Operations Manager to lead and elevate pharmacy services across our operations in Doha. This senior-level role demands excellence in regulatory compliance, operational leadership, team development, and customer-centered service delivery.
q: Education: Bachelor’s degree in Pharmacy (PharmD preferred). Advanced degrees in Pharmacy Administration, Healthcare Management, or Business Administration are a strong advantage
Licensing: Must hold a valid pharmacist license in Qatar; experience with controlled substances licensing is highly desirable
Minimum 5 years in pharmacy operations management; 7–10 years in senior roles ideal.

d: Ravensthorpe Restaurant is building its pre-opening Kitchen Team for a distinctive new hospitality concept in Adliya, Manama.
The venue will feature approximately 100 seats, offering both an accessible casual dining experience and a refined premium steakhouse experience within one cohesive culinary identity.

At the heart of Ravensthorpe is a bold concept inspired by Nordic and medieval European traditions, old-world European character, rustic elegance, contemporary technique, and the strength of a modern European grill and steakhouse approach.

This is a unique opportunity to join a new restaurant from the beginning and become part of a culinary team that will help shape the identity, quality, consistency, and long-term success of the opening.
The kitchen team will play a key role in delivering a menu that balances creativity, strong technique, operational discipline, guest appeal, and consistency across every service.
q: Previous experience as a Chef De Cuisine or a similar hospitality leadership position is preferred.
Strong knowledge of European/international cuisine and modern culinary techniques.
Strong menu planning and recipe development skills.
Ability to manage and motivate a multicultural kitchen team.
r: li
Assist with kitchen setup and equipment requirements
li
Oversee the daily operation of the kitchen.
li
Develop, update, and execute menus in collaboration with management.
li
Create recipes and establish standardized portion sizes and preparation methods.
li
Ensure proper storage and rotation of food products using FIFO principles.

Opportunity to grow with the brand from the opening stage

d: Established in 2018, Bybit is one of the world’s leading cryptocurrency exchanges and digital financial platforms, serving over 80 million users across more than 200 countries and regions. Powered by world-class technology and a user-first mindset, Bybit delivers a seamless ecosystem across trading, payments, wealth management, custody, institutional services, and Web3 — connecting users to the future of digital finance.

Our core values define how we build. We listen, care and improve to create products and experiences that put users first. Backed by a global team of ambitious builders, problem-solvers, and innovators, we foster a high-performance and fast-moving environment where talent is empowered to drive real impact at the global scale. Supported by 24/7 multilingual customer service and a strong commitment to innovation, we are shaping the future of finance through technology, collaboration, and bold execution.

Today, Bybit is recognized as one of the most trusted and transparent platforms in the digital asset industry, continuing to expand its global presence while building the infrastructure for the next generation of financial services.

The Regional Sales Lead owns the affiliate growth strategy and execution for the MENA market, reporting into our MENA Country Manager. You'll be on the ground — sourcing and building relationships with crypto communities, KOLs, HNW individuals, and professional traders to drive user acquisition and deepen Bybit's presence in one of the world's most active retail crypto markets
q: 3+ years of solid experience in cryptocurrency, FX, fintech, or financial services — with a demonstrable track record of building affiliate networks or BD pipelines from scratch
Business development or affiliate management experience — you understand the mechanics of referral economics, commission structures, and partner lifecycle management
Strong project management skills — comfortable juggling multiple partner relationships, campaigns, and deadlines simultaneously
Data-driven mindset — you understand acquisition OKRs (CPA, LTV, ROI, deposit conversion, volume per referred user) and use segmentation and analytics to optimize performance
Self-starter mentality — you don't wait for instructions; you find the opportunity and bring the plan
Previous experience at a crypto exchange — you know how exchange BD works
Experience working across time zones and cross-cultural teams in a global organization
Genuine passion for blockchain technology, DeFi, and the evolving crypto payments space
r: li
Affiliate Network Building: Proactively identify, recruit, and develop affiliates with communities of HNW clients, professional traders, and active crypto participants.
li

KOL & Influencer Partnerships: Source and manage relationships with crypto KOLs, influencers, and media channels — negotiate campaigns, co-branded content, and referral programs that drive registrations and trading volume on Bybit
li

HNW Client Management: Build and maintain direct relationships with high-net-worth individuals and trading groups; serve as their primary Bybit contact, ensuring they have access to relevant products (OTC desk, VIP programs, institutional-grade features)
li
User Acquisition Strategy: Devise creative, locally-relevant approaches to acquire users — going beyond standard playbooks to find what works in unique crypto landscape
li
Market Intelligence: Stay on top of crypto regulation, competitor activity (local and global exchanges), and community sentiment — feed insights back to regional and global leadership
li
Performance Optimization: Own and report on affiliate acquisition of OKRs — registration, deposit conversion, trading volume, retention — and iterate based on data to improve ROI
li
Cross-functional Collaboration: Work closely with Bybit's product, compliance, marketing, and VIP teams to localize offerings and ensure the Mandarin-speaking user experience is best-in-class

d: Amana Healthcare, brought to you by M42 and Mumtalakat, is pleased to announce the first Amana Healthcare facility in Bahrain, located in Al Jasra. This world-class hospital will provide long-term care and post-acute rehabilitation services.

M42 delivers comprehensive healthcare services across the full continuum of care; from primary care to advanced specialty treatments. Leveraging cutting-edge health technologies and precision medicine, we ensure the highest standards of effectiveness, efficiency, and patient-centered outcomes. With a global presence spanning more than 480 facilities in 27 countries and a dedicated workforce of over 20,000 professionals, M42 is uniquely positioned to redefine the future of healthcare on a global scale.

Reporting to the Manager, Rehabilitation/ Social and Behavioral Services / Senior Therapist or SLP, the Speech and Language Pathologist is responsible for assessing and treating patients with swallowing, speech and language disorders by utilizing best practices in patient healthcare in adherence with NHRA and M42 policies, procedures, guidelines and standards.
q: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Speech and Language Pathology / Speech Therapy from a recognized university.
Valid professional license/registration to practice in Bahrain (NHRA license) or eligibility to obtain one.
Minimum 6 years’ experience as a Speech and Language Pathologist, preferably in a hospital or long-term care setting.
Experience in managing adult neurological conditions (e.g., stroke, traumatic brain injury, Parkinson’s, dementia) is highly desirable.
r: li
Assess and diagnose communication, speech, language, and swallowing disorders in patients across all age groups.
li
Develop individualized treatment plans tailored to each patient’s needs, goals, and medical condition.
li
Deliver evidence-based therapy for patients with communication difficulties (e.g., aphasia, dysarthria, apraxia, stuttering, voice disorders).
li
Manage and treat swallowing disorders (dysphagia), including conducting bedside and instrumental swallowing assessments.
li
Collaborate with multidisciplinary teams (physicians, nurses, physiotherapists, occupational therapists, dietitians, and psychologists) to ensure comprehensive patient care.
li
Educate and counsel patients, families, and caregivers on therapy goals, home programs, and communication strategies.
li
Document assessments, treatment plans, progress notes, and outcome measures accurately in the hospital’s medical record system.
li
Participate in case conferences, family meetings, and care planning discussions.
li
Support training and development of nursing staff and caregivers in managing communication and swallowing issues.
li
Stay up to date with advances in speech-language pathology practices and participate in continuous professional development.
li
Ensure compliance with Bahrain health regulations, ethical standards, and hospital policies.
